sample_unit: imaging cases (MRI knee, MRI lumbar spine, CT head, CT abdomen/pelvis)

links.outcome: Whether radiologist review corrects errors in AI-drafted reports
links.effect: Minor formatting errors and occasional anatomical misinterpretations in AI reports were easily corrected by the radiologist during review; accuracy rated 4.65 vs 3.81 with dictation (p<0.0001).
links.quote: Minor formatting errors and occasional anatomical misinterpretations were observed in AI-generated reports, but could be easily corrected by the radiologist during review.

unlisted_practices: Radiologist enters key positive findings so AI generates a full draft report (AI-assisted structured reporting)

screen.reason: Evaluates a semi-automated AI drafting workflow where a radiologist inputs positive findings and reviews the AI-generated draft, comparing this human-in-the-loop deployment against standard dictation.

primary.practice: AI-assisted report generation with human review and validation
